what: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights, read as the structure shared by the frozen set of its editions: the immutable core of this mind. Everything after it is a record of what the mind encountered and how that changed it.
rule: No record may be appended to this domain. The first `bytes` bytes of mind.eot must equal `prefixSha256`. A later reading may disagree with the core; it records the disagreement in its own domain and never edits the core.
